feeds.title: Australian Ageing Agenda
feeds.description: Australian Ageing Agenda is an independent and authoritative bi-monthly publication for the aged care and retirement sectors in Australia. It provides a broad range of news, education and opinion with an emphasis on research and analysis in articles that challenge current ideas and encourage innovative thinking.

feeds.title: Your Time Magazine
feeds.description: Your Time Magazine is a 55 baby boomers to seniors magazine created for on the Sunshine Coast and Brisbane.

feeds.title: Australian Seniors News
feeds.description: Read the latest news and trends in Aged Care, Elder abuse and more. Your Australian Seniors News team is dedicated to bringing you stories from all of Australia's leading Seniors organizations, along with news, current affairs, and lifestyle features that are of interest to the growing Seniors community across the country.

feeds.title: Talius Group Limited
feeds.description: The Talius smart care platform is combined with world-class nurse call systems and solves all these challenges in a simple way by unlocking the power in your data to deliver better resident, staff and business outcomes. Their technological solutions are designed to help aged care businesses to improve outcomes for residents while maintaining optimal occupancy. It uses advanced predictive interpretation to automatically detect anomalies and complete proportional actions. Visit their blog to know about challenges, solutions, products, services, features, and more.

feeds.title: Aged Care Decisions
feeds.description: All the up-to-date news in Australian Aged Care. Everything you need from Nursing Homes to Home Care Services. We are a team of people who are passionate about helping Australian families through the aged care journey. Our mission to help families looking for aged care started in 2013 with Aged Care Reviews and evolved into Aged Care Decisions in 2016.

feeds.title: Senior Helpers Australia
feeds.description: Keep up to date with the latest industry news and Senior Helpers updates. At Senior Helpers, we are passionate about making a real difference in peoples' lives. Since 2011, we've helped connect thousands of Australians with compatible aged care and disability care, supporting clients in their wish to remain happy and healthy in their own homes.

feeds.title: Seniors First Blog
feeds.description: Get all the latest reverse mortgage news at the Seniors First blog. CEO Darren Moffatt writes on lender news, industry changes, & tips for senior borrowers. Seniors First was established in 2006 by founder Darren Moffatt with a vision of becoming one of the leading Reverse Mortgage companies for Australians over 60.

feeds.title: Australian Senior Golfer
feeds.description: ASG was established in April 2008 and from the outset our vision was not just to provide news and information about older golfers and associated issues, but resources of interest to older golfers. So we bring you all the latest golf news, views, golf equipment, golf tips, instruction, golf travel, special features and information and over time have built into a valuable online golf resource.

feeds.title: The Village Retirement Group Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with the latest news and events. Our blog covers everything from health and wellness tips to community news and resident stories. The Village Retirement Group offers independent living retirement communities across Brisbane & Toowoomba. Multi-award winning and family owned, we invite you to experience great retirement without leaving the area that you love living in.

feeds.title: Seasons Blog
feeds.description: Read our latest news, information about the retirement village industry, as well as senior health articles, inspiring stories, old-fashioned tips and tricks and recipes. Seasons is unique, offering the luxury and convenience of a retirement village combined with the peace of mind of 24/7 onsite care and support, if and when you need it.

feeds.title: Australian Seniors Advantage Group Blog
feeds.description: Australian seniors advisory group is dedicated to helping the increasing number of senior Australians achieve financial peace of mind in their retirement. Their senior advance solutions are designed to provide individualized, personalized solutions. They assist you in planning to live the life you have earned and now deserve. Their objective is to enjoy the wealth you have created. Their aim is to provide you with the solutions to make that happen. Check out their blog to know more.

feeds.title: HealthEngine » Senior's Health
feeds.description: At Healthengine, you can find the right care, connect with healthcare providers and manage your healthcare, all in one place. We're here to help you get a better experience across each step of your healthcare journey, making healthcare more affordable, convenient and certain. Explore our blog articles on senior's health, wellness tips, healthcare and more!

feeds.title: Australian Over 50s Living & Lifestyle Guide
feeds.description: The Australian over 50s living and lifestyle guide is a social enterprise, committed to improving the well-being of their nation's retirees and seniors. Their aim is to empower their readers with information they need to make the best choices for themselves. Check out their comprehensive blog posts providing information and advices for elders to help you lead a happy, healthy, and active life.

feeds.title: Home Care Assistance Blog
feeds.description: At Home Care Assistance, we will work with you or your loved one on ensuring your emergency care plan is up to date, as your safety is paramount. Our mission at Home Care Assistance is to change the way the world ages. We provide older adults with quality care that enables them to live happier, healthier lives at home. Our services are distinguished by the caliber of our caregivers, the responsiveness of our staff and our expertise in Live-In care.

feeds.title: Retirement Now
feeds.description: Aged Care Prepare came into existence by Renae and Nicky to support older Australians and their families to navigate through their retirement and aged care journeys. They continues to assist the ageing community, their relatives and friends, by answering the questions that they have regarding aging, aged care, and accommodation options. The team is specialized in home care as a home care package manager. Check into their blog and learn more about parenting tips, their care, latest news, nutrition, and more.

feeds.title: Go55s
feeds.description: Go55s publishes insightful stories and useful information to our readers. The magazine is upbeat & a celebration of the joy and wisdom that comes as we grow older.
